rows.grounds: sacred syllable oṃ as object of utterance
agent qualified by knowledge of mantras; compound mantra+vid

items.question: In what tonal manner must the mantra-knower utter the praṇava?
premises: The mantra-knower is the prescribed agent of utterance.
The object to be uttered is the praṇava.
The utterance must be performed with a single tone.
items.inference: Therefore, the mantra-knower should utter the praṇava in a single tone.
items.plain_english: But the mantra-knower should utter the praṇava with a single tone.
